headline: Wilmington and Felician yet to lose in conference play
dek: Felician kept pace with a home win over Goldey-Beacom, and both sides now go into the last round of conference play. Every defeat either has taken came before the conference opened: Wilmington's three sit in a season of nine wins and five draws.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Goals have not decided the table: Bridgeport have scored 38 and conceded 35, in a season of six wins, three draws and seven defeats.

wire.line: A win over Jefferson would leave Wilmington top of the conference table whatever Felician do at Post.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gijs van Eif has scored eight goals for Georgian Court and assisted eight more, from 60 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mathias Kristoffersen has kept eight shutouts for Felician and conceded ten goals all season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Goldey-Beacom have conceded 56 goals, more than any other programme in the conference, in a season of one win, three draws and thirteen defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dane Bodziak has scored eight goals for Chestnut Hill from 16 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bruno Mestres has made 96 saves for Holy Family and conceded 21 goals.

last_match.line: Felician have finished their conference home schedule unbeaten; Goldey-Beacom go to Georgian Court still without a conference win.

next_match.line: Wilmington have won every match they have played in October; Jefferson lost at home to Monroe last time out.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
